Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN

DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_GROUP_ID';
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة الاختيار ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .5);

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:U_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_GRP_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:U_GRP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_GRP_STATUS',TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_USR_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.USR_TYPE);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_DCLN_GROP_SHIFT.fmx',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,QUERY_ONLY,pl_id);
 IF :GLOBAL.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF F3DSHIFT(:U_PORT_CD,:GLOBAL.GROUP_ID,:GLOBAL.SHIFT_ID)=0 THEN
 IF TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI') > :GLOBAL.SHIFT_ET THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن تحضير فترة سابفة','ERROR');
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 /* ELSE
 IF TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI') > :GLOBAL.SHIFT_ET AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI') < :GLOBAL.SHIFT_ST THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن تحضير فترة سابفة','ERROR');
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
*/
 END IF;


 IF CHK_GRP(:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD,:GLOBAL.GROUP_ID) = 0 THEN
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 :U_GRP_CD := :GLOBAL.GROUP_ID;
 :U_GRP_NAME := :GLOBAL.GROUP_NAME ;
 :U_SHIFT_ID := :GLOBAL.SHIFT_ID ;
 :U_SHIFT_NAME := :GLOBAL.SFT_ANAME;
 GET_DTLS (1) ;
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END;

 CURSOR decl_Data IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, DCLTN_ISN
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE ( ( ( DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT >= NVL( :DATE_CASE ,:PARAMETER.DATE_CASE)
 AND ( (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (3, 7, 6 )
 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XSP
 WHERE XSP.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND XSP.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SUSPCT_STAGE_CD IN (1,2)
 AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4,5)
 AND NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH',21),0) = 1 ))
 AND :PARAMETER.P_IMP_WORK = 1
 AND (DECLARATIONS.DHL_BL IS NULL OR :PARAMETER.P_PRV_AVIATION = 1))
 OR (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5) AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (2) AND :PARAMETER.P_EXP_WORK=1))
 AND DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
 AND DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
 AND DECLARATIONS.INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND (NVL(DECLARATIONS.RECP_FLAG,0) = 1 OR NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0)=0 OR DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2))
 AND (NVL(DECLARATIONS.RECP_FLAG,0) = 1 OR NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURSEXP',21),0)=0 OR DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2))
 AND ((:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
 FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS XPR
 WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ISD_RESULT IS NULL
 AND NVL(:PARAMETER.P_CR_8441, 0) = 1
 )) OR :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE != 4)
 )
 )
 );

Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_MESSAGE NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :U_GRP_CD IS NOT NULL AND :U_SHIFT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_MESSAGE := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;

 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25 ;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID <> 9086 THEN
 GO_BLOCK('DECLARATIONS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);

 GO_BLOCK('STATS_DCLTNS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSE
 GO_BLOCK('STATS_DCLTNS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);

 GO_BLOCK('TRANSITS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);
 END IF;


 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := V_MESSAGE;

 IF :U_MANUAL_SELECT = 1 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_DCLTN_DT', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_DCLTN_NBR', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('U_DCLTN_DT' , TRUE);
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('U_DCLTN_NBR', TRUE);
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD', TRUE);

 :U_CHK_ALL := 0;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_CHK_ALL', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 GO_ITEM('U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD');
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_DCLTN_DT', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_DCLTN_NBR', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('U_CHK_ALL', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحديد رقم المجموعة و الوردية أولا','ERROR');
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_insp_num NUMBER := 0;
 v_24hours NUMBER := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS', 21), 0);
 v_24hours_start_dt DATE
 := TO_DATE (
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_START_DT', 21),
 '1450-01-01'),
 'YYYY-MM-MI');
 v_24hoursexp NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURSEXP', 21), 0);
 v_24hoursexp_start_dt DATE
 := TO_DATE (
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURSEXP_START_DT', 21),
 '1450-01-01'),
 'YYYY-MM-MI');
 v_24hours_STATS NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_STATS', 27), 0);
 v_24hours_STATS_dt DATE
 := TO_DATE (
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_STATS_DT', 27),
 '1450-01-01'),
 'YYYY-MM-MI');

 CURSOR dcltn_rec_chk
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, dcltn_isn, GROUP_ID
 FROM declarations dcltn
 WHERE dcltn.port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND dcltn.GROUP_ID = :u_grp_cd
 AND (LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS (
 dcltn.PORT_CD,
 dcltn.DCLTN_ISN,
 1) = 1) -- CR3515
 AND ( NVL (dcltn.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 OR dcltn.dcltn_dt < v_24hours_start_dt
 OR v_24hours = 0
 OR dcltn_type_cd NOT IN (1, 2))
 AND ( NVL (dcltn.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 OR dcltn.dcltn_dt < v_24hoursexp_start_dt
 OR v_24hoursexp = 0
 OR dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2))
 AND ( dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 OR LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.BL_PARTS_APPLIED (
 dcltn.port_cd,
 dcltn.dcltn_isn) = 1)
 AND (DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLOW_DIST_WITH_PREVIEW (dcltn.PORT_CD,
 dcltn.DCLTN_ISN,
 1) = 1) -- MOHAMED TAHA CR-7431
 AND ( ( dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2) AND dcltn_sta_cd IN (3, 7)
 OR EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XSP
 WHERE XSP.PORT_CD = dcltn.PORT_CD
 AND XSP.DCLTN_ISN = dcltn.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SUSPCT_STAGE_CD IN (1, 2)
 AND dcltn.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4, 5)
 AND NVL (
 gnrl.get_customs_setting (
 'CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH',
 21),
 0) = 1))
 OR (dcltn_type_cd IN (3, 4, 5) AND dcltn_sta_cd IN (2)))
 AND dcltn.insptr_id IS NULL
 AND dcltn.lic_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT NULL
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = dcltn.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = dcltn.dcltn_isn);

 CURSOR dcltn_rec_unchk
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, dcltn_isn
 FROM declarations dcltn
 WHERE dcltn.port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND dcltn.GROUP_ID = :u_grp_cd
 AND ( ( dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2) AND dcltn_sta_cd IN (3, 7)
 OR EXISTS
 (SELECT 1
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XSP
 WHERE XSP.PORT_CD = dcltn.PORT_CD
 AND XSP.DCLTN_ISN = dcltn.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SUSPCT_STAGE_CD IN (1, 2)
 AND dcltn.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4, 5)
 AND NVL (
 gnrl.get_customs_setting (
 'CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH',
 21),
 0) = 1))
 OR (dcltn_type_cd IN (3, 4, 5) AND dcltn_sta_cd IN (2)))
 AND dcltn.insptr_id IS NULL
 AND dcltn.lic_nbr IS NOT NULL;

 CURSOR stats_rec_chk
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, stats_isn
 FROM stats_dcltns stats
 WHERE stats.port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND stats.grp_id = :u_grp_cd
 AND stats.stats_status IN (3)
 AND stats.insptr_nbr IS NULL
 AND stats.lic_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND ( stats.STATS_TYPE_CD IN (11, 13, 15)
 OR Prtl_nebras_services.stats_bl_parts_applied (
 stats.PORT_CD,
 stats.STATS_ISN) = 1)
 AND (STATS_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT (stats.PORT_CD,
 stats.STATS_ISN) = 1) -- MOHAMED TAHA CR-8440 07-04-2025
 AND (DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLOW_DIST_WITH_PREVIEW (stats.PORT_CD,
 stats.STATS_ISN,
 2) = 1) -- MOHAMED TAHA CR-7431
 AND (LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS (
 stats.PORT_CD,
 stats.stats_isn,
 2) = 1) -- CR3515
 AND ( NVL (stats.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 OR stats.STATS_dt < v_24hours_STATS_dt
 OR v_24hours_STATS = 0)
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT NULL
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = stats.port_cd
 AND stats_isn = stats.stats_isn);

 CURSOR stats_rec_unchk
 IS
 SELECT port_cd, stats_isn
 FROM stats_dcltns stats
 WHERE stats.port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND stats.grp_id = :u_grp_cd
 AND stats.stats_status IN (3)
 AND stats.insptr_nbr IS NULL
 AND stats.lic_nbr IS NOT NULL;

 CURSOR trnst_rec_chk
 IS
 SELECT sdp_port_cd,
 trnst_type,
 trnst_nbr,
 trnst_dt
 FROM transits trnst
 WHERE trnst.sdp_port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND trnst.GROUP_ID = :u_grp_cd
 AND trnst.trnst_status_cd >= 3
 AND trnst.transt_inspctr IS NULL
 AND trnst.brkr_lic_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT NULL
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = trnst.sdp_port_cd
 AND trnst_type = trnst.trnst_type
 AND trnst_nbr = trnst.trnst_nbr
 AND trnst_dt = trnst.trnst_dt);

 CURSOR trnst_rec_unchk
 IS
 SELECT sdp_port_cd,
 trnst_type,
 trnst_nbr,
 trnst_dt
 FROM transits trnst
 WHERE trnst.sdp_port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND trnst.GROUP_ID = :u_grp_cd
 AND trnst.trnst_status_cd >= 3
 AND trnst.transt_inspctr IS NULL
 AND trnst.brkr_lic_nbr IS NOT NULL;

 v_req_dt DATE;
 v_dcltn_level NUMBER;
 v_sta_dcltn_level NUMBER;
 v_trnst_level NUMBER;
 v_dcltn_exist NUMBER := 0;
 v_stats_exist NUMBER := 0;
 v_trnst_exist NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 SELECT insp_num
 INTO v_insp_num
 FROM dcltn_grps
 WHERE port_cd = :insptr_grps.u_port_cd AND grp_id = :insptr_grps.u_grp_cd;

 IF :u_chk_all = 1
 THEN
 v_req_dt := hijdate.cur_hij_date;

 IF :parameter.p_module_id <> 9086
 THEN
 FOR i IN dcltn_rec_chk
 LOOP
 v_dcltn_level := get_work_assign_level (i.port_cd, i.dcltn_isn);

 FOR ii IN 1 .. v_insp_num
 LOOP
 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns (port_cd,
 assign_isn,
 dcltn_isn,
 grp_id,
 insptr_id,
 assgin_dt,
 end_date,
 rmv_dt,
 rmv_rsn,
 req_dt,
 work_assign_level,
 re_grp_id,
 re_insptr_id)
 VALUES (i.port_cd,
 auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL,
 i.dcltn_isn,
 i.GROUP_ID,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 v_req_dt,
 v_dcltn_level,
 NULL,
 NULL);
 END LOOP;

 v_dcltn_exist := v_dcltn_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;

 FOR i IN stats_rec_chk
 LOOP
 v_sta_dcltn_level :=
 sta_get_work_assign_level (i.port_cd, i.stats_isn);

 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns (port_cd,
 assign_isn,
 dcltn_isn,
 grp_id,
 insptr_id,
 assgin_dt,
 end_date,
 rmv_dt,
 rmv_rsn,
 req_dt,
 work_assign_level,
 re_grp_id,
 re_insptr_id,
 stats_isn)
 VALUES (i.port_cd,
 auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 v_req_dt,
 v_sta_dcltn_level,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 i.stats_isn);

 v_stats_exist := v_stats_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 FOR i IN stats_rec_chk
 LOOP
 v_sta_dcltn_level :=
 sta_get_work_assign_level (i.port_cd, i.stats_isn);

 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns (port_cd,
 assign_isn,
 dcltn_isn,
 grp_id,
 insptr_id,
 assgin_dt,
 end_date,
 rmv_dt,
 rmv_rsn,
 req_dt,
 work_assign_level,
 re_grp_id,
 re_insptr_id,
 stats_isn)
 VALUES (i.port_cd,
 auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 v_req_dt,
 v_sta_dcltn_level,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 i.stats_isn);

 v_stats_exist := v_stats_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;

 FOR i IN trnst_rec_chk
 LOOP
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_LND')
 THEN
 SELECT NVL (num_of_vhcls, 1)
 INTO v_trnst_level
 FROM transits
 WHERE sdp_port_cd = i.sdp_port_cd
 AND trnst_nbr = i.trnst_nbr
 AND trnst_dt = i.trnst_dt
 AND trnst_type = i.trnst_type;
 ELSIF :parameter.p_port_type =
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 v_trnst_level := 1;
 END IF;

 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns (port_cd,
 assign_isn,
 req_dt,
 work_assign_level,
 trnst_nbr,
 trnst_type,
 trnst_dt)
 VALUES (i.sdp_port_cd,
 auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL,
 v_req_dt,
 v_trnst_level,
 i.trnst_nbr,
 i.trnst_type,
 i.trnst_dt);

 v_trnst_exist := v_trnst_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('U_MANUAL_SELECT ', enabled, property_false);
 ELSE
 IF :parameter.p_module_id <> 9086
 THEN
 FOR i IN dcltn_rec_unchk
 LOOP
 DELETE insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = i.port_cd AND dcltn_isn = i.dcltn_isn;

 v_dcltn_exist := v_dcltn_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;

 FOR i IN stats_rec_unchk
 LOOP
 DELETE insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = i.port_cd AND stats_isn = i.stats_isn;

 v_stats_exist := v_stats_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 FOR i IN stats_rec_unchk
 LOOP
 DELETE insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = i.port_cd AND stats_isn = i.stats_isn;

 v_stats_exist := v_stats_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;

 FOR i IN trnst_rec_unchk
 LOOP
 DELETE insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = i.sdp_port_cd
 AND trnst_nbr = i.trnst_nbr
 AND trnst_type = i.trnst_type
 AND trnst_dt = i.trnst_dt;

 v_trnst_exist := v_trnst_exist + 1;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('U_MANUAL_SELECT ', enabled, property_true);
 END IF;

 IF v_dcltn_exist > 0
 THEN
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 0;

 v_dcltn_exist := 0;
 GO_BLOCK ('DECLARATIONS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY (no_validate);
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY (
 GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DECLARATIONS', current_record),
 'DECLARATIONS',
 status,
 changed_status);
 END IF;

 IF v_stats_exist > 0
 THEN
 v_stats_exist := 0;
 GO_BLOCK ('STATS_DCLTNS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY (no_validate);
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY (
 GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('STATS_DCLTNS', current_record),
 'STATS_DCLTNS',
 status,
 changed_status);
 END IF;

 IF v_trnst_exist > 0
 THEN
 v_trnst_exist := 0;
 GO_BLOCK ('TRANSITS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY (no_validate);
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY (GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('TRANSITS', current_record),
 'TRANSITS',
 status,
 changed_status);
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 SELECT MAX(DCLTN_DT)
 INTO :U_DCLTN_DT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :U_DCLTN_NBR
 AND GROUP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD IN (3,5,7)
 AND INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
 ;
 ELSIF :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) THEN
 SELECT MAX(DCLTN_DT)
 INTO :U_DCLTN_DT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :U_DCLTN_NBR
 AND GROUP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD IN (2)
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD <> 6
 AND INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
 ;
 ELSIF :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (17,18) THEN

 SELECT MAX(TRNST_DT)
 INTO :U_DCLTN_DT
 FROM TRANSITS
 WHERE SDP_PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_TYPE = DECODE(:U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD,17,4,18,43)
 AND TRNST_NBR = :U_DCLTN_NBR
 AND GROUP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
 AND TRNST_STATUS_CD >= 3
 AND TRANST_INSPCTR IS NULL
 AND BRKR_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
 ;

 ELSE
 IF :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD <> 13 THEN
 SELECT MAX(STATS_DT)
 INTO :U_DCLTN_DT
 FROM STATS_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
 AND STATS_TYPE_CD = :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND STATS_NBR = :U_DCLTN_NBR
 AND GRP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
 AND STATS_TYPE_CD NOT IN (13,14)
 AND STATS_STATUS IN (3)
 AND INSPTR_NBR IS NULL
 AND LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
 ;
 ELSE
 SELECT MAX(STATS_DT)
 INTO :U_DCLTN_DT
 FROM STATS_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
 AND STATS_TYPE_CD = :U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND STATS_NBR = :U_DCLTN_NBR
 AND GRP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
 AND STATS_STATUS IN (3)
 AND INSPTR_NBR IS NULL
 AND LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد بيان جمركي يخصك قابل للتحضير بهذا الرقم ـ تأكد من نوع ورقم البيان','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 intrface.Disp_Calendar('H', 3, 2, FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 intrface.Disp_Calendar('H', 3, 2, FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 intrface.Disp_Calendar('H', 3, 2, FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 HDATE DATE;
BEGIN
 IF :System.TRIGGER_ITEM = :System.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN
 HDATE := TO_DATE(:System.Cursor_Value);

 IF NOT HIJDATE.VALID_HIJ_DATE(HDATE) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* Formatted on 2016/01/12 12:35 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
DECLARE
 v_insp_num NUMBER := 0;
 v_count NUMBER := 0;
 v_dcltn_isn NUMBER;
 v_req_dt DATE;
 v_dcltn_level NUMBER;
 v_trnst_nbr NUMBER;
 v_trnst_type NUMBER;
 v_trnst_dt DATE;
 v_trnst_level NUMBER;
 v_24hours NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS', 21), 0);
 v_24hours_start_dt DATE
 := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_START_DT', 21),
 '1450-01-01'
 ),
 'YYYY-MM-MI'
 );

 v_24hoursexp NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURSEXP', 21), 0);
 v_24hoursexp_start_dt DATE
 := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURSEXP_START_DT', 21),
 '1450-01-01'
 ),
 'YYYY-MM-MI'
 );
 v_24hours_STATS NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_STATS', 27), 0);
 v_24hours_STATS_dt DATE
 := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_STATS_DT', 27),
 '1450-01-01'
 ),
 'YYYY-MM-MI'
 );
 V_DHL NUMBER;
 V_PORT_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_GRP_ID DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID%TYPE;
 V_ASSIGN_ISN INSPTR_DCLTNS.ASSIGN_ISN%TYPE;

BEGIN

 SELECT insp_num
 INTO v_insp_num
 FROM dcltn_grps
 WHERE port_cd = :insptr_grps.u_port_cd AND grp_id = :insptr_grps.u_grp_cd;

 IF :u_dcltn_type_cd IS NOT NULL
 AND :u_dcltn_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND :u_dcltn_dt IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF :u_dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
 THEN
 IF :u_dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 SELECT dcltn_isn
 INTO v_dcltn_isn
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :u_dcltn_type_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :u_dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_dt = :u_dcltn_dt
 AND GROUP_ID = :u_grp_cd
 AND dcltn_sta_cd IN (3, 7,4,5)
 AND dcltn_dt > :parameter.date_case
 AND insptr_id IS NULL
 AND lic_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND (LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS(PORT_CD,DCLTN_ISN,1) = 1) -- CR3515
 AND (NVL(RECP_FLAG,0) = 1 OR dcltn_dt < v_24hours_start_dt OR v_24hours=0);
 ELSIF :u_dcltn_type_cd IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 THEN
 SELECT dcltn_isn
 INTO v_dcltn_isn
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND dcltn_type_cd = :u_dcltn_type_cd
 AND dcltn_nbr = :u_dcltn_nbr
 AND dcltn_dt = :u_dcltn_dt
 AND GROUP_ID = :u_grp_cd
 AND dcltn_dt > :parameter.date_case
 AND dcltn_sta_cd IN (2)
 AND dcltn_type_cd <> 6
 AND insptr_id IS NULL
 AND lic_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND (LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS(PORT_CD,DCLTN_ISN,1) = 1) -- CR3515
 AND (NVL(RECP_FLAG,0) = 1 OR dcltn_dt < v_24hoursexp_start_dt OR v_24hoursexp=0)
 AND LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.BL_PARTS_APPLIED(port_cd,dcltn_isn) = 1;
------ YASSER HASSAN START 08042021
SADR_INI;
------------END------------
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL;

 V_PORT_TYPE := HOURS24.GET_PORT_TYPE (:u_port_cd);

 SELECT NVL(DHL_BL, 0), GROUP_ID
 INTO V_DHL, V_GRP_ID
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn;

 IF v_count > 0 THEN
 IF V_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND V_DHL > 0 THEN
 str.dispalert ('البيان تابع لمجموعات البريد السريع ... يجب التعامل معه عن طريق نظام منافذ', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert ('المعاملة المدخلة تم تحضيرها والتعامل معها من قبل', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 v_req_dt := hijdate.cur_hij_date;
 v_dcltn_level := get_work_assign_level (:u_port_cd, v_dcltn_isn);

 FOR ii IN 1 .. v_insp_num LOOP

 IF LIB_APX_USR.XRAY_PENDING_PKG.MOAEEN_DISTRUBE_CHK(:u_port_cd, v_dcltn_isn) = 1 THEN --IBRAHIM hot fix 24-04-2024

 IF V_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND V_DHL = 1 THEN
 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns
 (port_cd, assign_isn, dcltn_isn,
 grp_id, insptr_id, assgin_dt, end_date, rmv_dt,
 rmv_rsn, req_dt, work_assign_level, re_grp_id,
 re_insptr_id
 )
 VALUES (:u_port_cd, auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL, v_dcltn_isn,
 NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, v_req_dt, v_dcltn_level, NULL,
 NULL
 );
 ELSE
 ----- AYMAN GAD 08-01-2026 CRQ
 SELECT auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL
 INTO V_ASSIGN_ISN
 FROM DUAL;

 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns
 (port_cd, assign_isn, dcltn_isn,
 grp_id, insptr_id, assgin_dt, end_date, rmv_dt,
 rmv_rsn, req_dt, work_assign_level, re_grp_id,
 re_insptr_id)
 VALUES (:u_port_cd, V_ASSIGN_ISN, V_DCLTN_ISN,
 V_GRP_ID, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, v_req_dt, v_dcltn_level, NULL,
 NULL);

 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET RMV_DT = LIB_USR.HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE,
 RMV_RSN = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :u_port_cd
 AND ASSIGN_ISN <> V_ASSIGN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND RMV_DT IS NULL;

 END IF;

 END IF ;

 END LOOP;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 GO_BLOCK ('DECLARATIONS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY (no_validate);
 :u_dcltn_type_cd := 1;
 -- :u_dcltn_nbr := NULL;
 -- :u_dcltn_dt := NULL;
 GO_ITEM ('U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD');
 END IF;
-- ---
 ELSIF :u_dcltn_type_cd IN (17, 18)
 THEN
 SELECT trnst_type, trnst_nbr, trnst_dt
 INTO v_trnst_type, v_trnst_nbr, v_trnst_dt
 FROM transits
 WHERE sdp_port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND trnst_type = DECODE (:u_dcltn_type_cd, 17, 4, 18, 43)
 AND trnst_nbr = :u_dcltn_nbr
 AND trnst_dt = :u_dcltn_dt
 AND GROUP_ID = :u_grp_cd
 AND trnst_status_cd >= 3
 AND trnst_dt > :parameter.date_case
 AND transt_inspctr IS NULL
 AND brkr_lic_nbr IS NOT NULL;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND trnst_type = v_trnst_type
 AND trnst_nbr = v_trnst_nbr
 AND trnst_dt = v_trnst_dt
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL;

 IF v_count > 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('المعاملة المدخلة تم تحضيرها والتعامل معها من قبل',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 v_req_dt := hijdate.cur_hij_date;

 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_LND')
 THEN
 SELECT NVL (num_of_vhcls, 0)
 INTO v_trnst_level
 FROM transits
 WHERE sdp_port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND trnst_nbr = :u_dcltn_nbr
 AND trnst_dt = :u_dcltn_dt
 AND trnst_type = DECODE (:u_dcltn_type_cd, 17, 4, 18, 43);

 IF v_trnst_level = 0
 THEN
 v_trnst_level := 1;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :parameter.p_port_type =
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 v_trnst_level := 1;
 END IF;

 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns
 (port_cd, assign_isn, req_dt,
 work_assign_level, trnst_type, trnst_nbr, trnst_dt
 )
 VALUES (:u_port_cd, auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL, v_req_dt,
 v_trnst_level, v_trnst_type, v_trnst_nbr, v_trnst_dt
 );

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 GO_BLOCK ('TRANSITS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY (no_validate);
 :u_dcltn_type_cd := 17;
 -- :u_dcltn_nbr := NULL;
 -- :u_dcltn_dt := NULL;
 GO_ITEM ('U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD');
 END IF;
-- ---
 ELSE
 IF :u_dcltn_type_cd <> 13
 THEN
 SELECT stats_isn
 INTO v_dcltn_isn
 FROM stats_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND stats_type_cd = :u_dcltn_type_cd
 AND stats_nbr = :u_dcltn_nbr
 AND grp_id = :u_grp_cd
 AND stats_status = 3
 AND stats_type_cd NOT IN (13, 14)
 AND stats_dt > :parameter.date_case
 AND insptr_nbr IS NULL
 AND (LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS(PORT_CD,stats_isn,2) = 1) -- CR3515
 AND (NVL(RECP_FLAG,0) = 1 OR STATS_dt < v_24hours_STATS_dt OR v_24hours_STATS=0)
 AND lic_nbr IS NOT NULL;
 ELSE
 SELECT stats_isn
 INTO v_dcltn_isn
 FROM stats_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND stats_type_cd = :u_dcltn_type_cd
 AND stats_nbr = :u_dcltn_nbr
 AND grp_id = :u_grp_cd
 AND stats_status = 3
 AND stats_dt > :parameter.date_case
 AND insptr_nbr IS NULL
 AND (LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS(PORT_CD,stats_isn,2) = 1) -- CR3515
 AND (NVL(RECP_FLAG,0) = 1 OR STATS_dt < v_24hours_STATS_dt OR v_24hours_STATS=0)
 AND lic_nbr IS NOT NULL;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :u_port_cd
 AND stats_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND rmv_dt IS NULL;

 IF v_count > 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('المعاملة المدخلة تم تحضيرها والتعامل معها من قبل',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 v_req_dt := hijdate.cur_hij_date;
 v_dcltn_level :=
 sta_get_work_assign_level (:u_port_cd, v_dcltn_isn);

 FOR ii IN 1 .. v_insp_num
 LOOP
 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns
 (port_cd, assign_isn, dcltn_isn, grp_id,
 insptr_id, assgin_dt, end_date, rmv_dt, rmv_rsn,
 req_dt, work_assign_level, re_grp_id,
 re_insptr_id, stats_isn
 )
 VALUES (:u_port_cd, auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
 v_req_dt, v_dcltn_level, NULL,
 NULL, v_dcltn_isn
 );
 END LOOP;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 GO_BLOCK ('STATS_DCLTNS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY (no_validate);

 IF :u_dcltn_type_cd <> 13
 THEN
 :u_dcltn_type_cd := 1;
 ELSE
 :u_dcltn_type_cd := 13;
 END IF;

 -- :u_dcltn_nbr := NULL;
 -- :u_dcltn_dt := NULL;
 GO_ITEM ('U_DCLTN_TYPE_CD');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('لا يوجد بيان يخصك قابل للتحضير بهذا الرقم ـ تأكد من نوع ورقم البيان',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CREATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 G_DATE DATE;
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER;
 V_SHIFT_ID NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_CNT1 NUMBER;
 V_CNT2 NUMBER;
 V_USR_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_SFT_ETIME DATE;
 V_SFT_STIME DATE;
 V_CHCK_ROLE_PRIVS BOOLEAN:=CHCK_ROLE_PRIVS;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT
 FROM
 (
 SELECT GRP_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE
(
 MGR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 OR (DEPUTY_MGR_ID IS NOT NULL AND DEPUTY_MGR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID)
 )
 AND GRP_STATUS = 1
 UNION
 SELECT SHIFT_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
 WHERE ((MANGER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ) OR (DEPUTY_MGR_ID=:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID))
 AND STATUS = 1
 )
 ;
 IF V_CNT = 0 AND V_CHCK_ROLE_PRIVS=FALSE THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('ليس لديك صلاحية التعامل مع الشاشة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 :INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;
 SELECT PORT_NAME
 INTO :INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_NAME
 FROM SD_PORTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_GRP_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE ( MGR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 OR (DEPUTY_MGR_ID IS NOT NULL AND DEPUTY_MGR_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID)
 )
 AND GRP_STATUS = 1
 ;
 V_USR_TYPE := 1 ; -- رئيس مجموعة او نائبه

 SELECT SHIFT_ID INTO V_SHIFT_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
 WHERE GRP_ID = V_GRP_ID AND STATUS = 1
 ;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 :GLOBAL.USR_TYPE := 1 ; -- رئيس مجموعة او نائبه
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT GRP_ID
 INTO V_GRP_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
 WHERE ((MANGER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ) OR (DEPUTY_MGR_ID=:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID)) AND STATUS = 1
 ;
 SELECT SHIFT_ID,SFT_ETIME
 INTO V_SHIFT_ID
,V_SFT_ETIME
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
 WHERE GRP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND ((MANGER = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ) OR (DEPUTY_MGR_ID=:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID)) AND STATUS = 1
 ;
 V_USR_TYPE := 2 ; -- رئيس الوردية
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 :GLOBAL.USR_TYPE := 2 ; -- رئيس الوردية

 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 IF V_CHCK_ROLE_PRIVS=FALSE THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('ليس لديك صلاحية التعامل مع الشاشة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END ;
 END;

 IF V_GRP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF CHK_GRP(:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD,V_GRP_ID) = 0 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
--------------------------------------------------------




 IF V_GRP_ID IS NOT NULL AND V_SHIFT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD := V_GRP_ID;
 SELECT GRP_NAME
 INTO :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 ;

 :INSPTR_GRPS.U_SHIFT_ID := V_SHIFT_ID;
 SELECT SFT_ANAME
 INTO :INSPTR_GRPS.U_SHIFT_NAME
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD
 AND SHIFT_ID = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_SHIFT_ID
 ;
 END IF;
 :GLOBAL.SHIFT_ET:=TO_CHAR(V_SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI');
 IF F3DSHIFT(:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD,:INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD,:INSPTR_GRPS.U_SHIFT_ID )=0 THEN

 IF TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI') >TO_CHAR(V_SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI') THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن تحضير فترة سابفة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 /* ELSE
 IF TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI') > TO_CHAR(V_SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI') < TO_CHAR(V_SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI') THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن تحضير فترة سابفة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;*/
 END IF;
 IF V_CHCK_ROLE_PRIVS=TRUE THEN
 :GLOBAL.USR_TYPE:=0;
 :U_GRP_NAME:=NULL;
 :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD:=NULL;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 END IF;
END;



begin -- maih
 if :U_GRP_CD IS NOT NULL then
 CHK_DCLTN_GRP ;
 end if;
END ;



IF CHECK_DCLN_GROUP(:U_GRP_CD) = 0 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('المجموعة الجمركية غير فعال التوزيع الالي عليها','ERROR');
RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
GET_DTLS(0) ; -- make screen slow change by nouh
END;

Block.Name: DECLARATIONS
Block.WhereClause:
WHERE ( ( ( ( DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_DT >= NVL( :DATE_CASE ,:PARAMETER.DATE_CASE)
AND
(
(DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND (DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (3, 7, 6 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XSP WHERE XSP.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND XSP.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN AND SUSPCT_STAGE_CD in (1,2)
 AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4,5) AND NVL (
 gnrl.get_customs_setting (
 'CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH',
 21),
 0) = 1 ))
AND :PARAMETER.P_IMP_WORK=1 AND
( DECLARATIONS.DHL_BL IS NULL OR :PARAMETER.P_PRV_AVIATION=1)
)
OR
(
DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5) AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (2,8) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XSP WHERE XSP.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND XSP.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN AND SUSPCT_STAGE_CD in (1,2)
 AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (11) AND NVL (
 gnrl.get_customs_setting (
 'CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH',
 21),
 0) = 1 ))
AND :PARAMETER.P_EXP_WORK=1)
)
AND
DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
AND
DECLARATIONS.GROUP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
AND
DECLARATIONS.INSPTR_ID IS NULL
AND
DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
AND (nvl(DECLARATIONS.RECP_FLAG,0) = 1 OR NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('24HOURS',21),0)=0 OR DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2))

AND ((:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS XPR WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN AND ISD_RESULT IS NULL AND NVL(:PARAMETER.P_CR_8441, 0) = 1)) OR :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE != 4 )
)
)
)

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF :PREEXIST = 1 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT REQ_DT
 INTO :DECLARATIONS.U_REQ_DT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DECLARATIONS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :U_REQ_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DECLARATIONS',STATUS, CHANGED_STATUS);
 END;
 ELSE SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND REQ_DT = :U_REQ_DT
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;


 :U_REQ_DT := NULL;
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DECLARATIONS',STATUS, CHANGED_STATUS);
 ELSE

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DECLARATIONS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'DECLARATIONS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

 ,:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD ); /* IN : Value in Item :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 EXCEPTION

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع المعاملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DCLTN_STA_CD,DCLTN_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,IMPR_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم مجموعة المعاينة,رمز الميناء' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

DECLARE

BEGIN
 SELECT insp_num
 INTO v_insp_num
 FROM dcltn_grps
 WHERE port_cd = :insptr_grps.u_port_cd AND grp_id = :insptr_grps.u_grp_cd;

 IF :preexist = 1
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND assgin_dt IS NULL;

 IF v_count = 0
 THEN
 FOR ii IN 1 .. v_insp_num
 LOOP
 SELECT auto_assgn_isn.NEXTVAL
 INTO v_assgn_isn
 FROM DUAL;
IF LIB_APX_USR.XRAY_PENDING_PKG.MOAEEN_DISTRUBE_CHK (:declarations.port_cd , :declarations.dcltn_isn) = 1 THEN --IBRAHIM hot fix 24-04-2024

 INSERT INTO insptr_dcltns
 (port_cd, assign_isn,
 dcltn_isn, grp_id, insptr_id, assgin_dt, end_date,
 rmv_dt, rmv_rsn, req_dt, work_assign_level,
 re_grp_id, re_insptr_id
 )
 VALUES (:declarations.port_cd, v_assgn_isn,
 :declarations.dcltn_isn, :declarations.group_id, NULL, NULL, NULL,
 NULL, NULL, :declarations.u_req_dt, :u_dcltn_level,
 NULL, NULL
 );
END IF ;
 END LOOP;

 IF NOT activity.add_activity (21,
 15,
 4,
 :declarations.port_cd
 || '!'
 || v_assgn_isn
 )
 THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF v_count = 1
 THEN
 UPDATE insptr_dcltns
 SET work_assign_level = :u_dcltn_level
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND assgin_dt IS NULL;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert ('خطأ في تحضير المعاملة الجمركية', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 DELETE insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :declarations.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :declarations.dcltn_isn
 AND assgin_dt IS NULL;
 END IF;
END;

Block.Name: STATS_DCLTNS
Block.WhereClause:
WHERE ( ( STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_DT > :PARAMETER.DATE_CASE
AND
STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
AND
STATS_DCLTNS.GRP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
AND
STATS_DCLTNS.INSPTR_NBR IS NULL
AND
STATS_DCLTNS.LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
AND
STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_STATUS = 3
AND
(
(:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID <> 9086)
OR
(STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_TYPE_CD = 13 AND :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID = 9086)
)
)
)

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF :STA_PREEXIST = 1 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT REQ_DT
 INTO :STATS_DCLTNS.STA_U_REQ_DT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = :STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('STATS_DCLTNS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'STATS_DCLTNS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :STATS_DCLTNS.STA_U_REQ_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('STATS_DCLTNS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'STATS_DCLTNS',STATUS, CHANGED_STATUS);
 END;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = :STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN
 AND REQ_DT = :STA_U_REQ_DT
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;


 :STA_U_REQ_DT := NULL;
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('STATS_DCLTNS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'STATS_DCLTNS',STATUS, CHANGED_STATUS);
 ELSE

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('STATS_DCLTNS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'STATS_DCLTNS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SD_USR_TERMN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TRT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRANSPORTER_CODE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TOT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRNST_OWNER_TYPE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TBA_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,TRNST_BRK_AUTHR_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SPCL_DEPT_ID' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_SDP_OTHER_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'OTHR_PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_SDP_AT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك الحالي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_INSPTR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستورد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_GRP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المجموعة الجمركية', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_CTRY_DUTY_FROM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز دولة الدخول الأولى للبيان الإحصائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_CTRY_DUTY_FOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي للبيان الإحصائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات المخلص', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_BI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم التفويض للمخلص', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى سبب تحديد نوع المعاملة (المشغل الأقتصادى)', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT RV_MEANING INTO :STATS_DCLTN_TYP
 FROM CG_REF_CODES
 WHERE RV_DOMAIN = 'STATS_TYPE'
 AND RV_LOW_VALUE = :STATS_TYPE_CD;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT REQ_DT, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
 INTO :STATS_DCLTNS.STA_U_REQ_DT, :STATS_DCLTNS.STA_U_DCLTN_LEVEL
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = :STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;

 :STA_U_CNTNR_CNT := STA_GET_CNTR_CNT;
 :STA_PREEXIST := 1;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('STATS_DCLTNS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'STATS_DCLTNS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 IF :U_MANUAL_SELECT = 1 THEN

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 :STA_PREEXIST := NULL;
 :STA_U_DCLTN_LEVEL := STA_GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL(:STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD,:STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN);
 :STA_U_CNTNR_CNT := STA_GET_CNTR_CNT;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('STATS_DCLTNS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'STATS_DCLTNS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_ASSGN_ISN NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :STA_PREEXIST = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = :STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;
 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 SELECT AUTO_ASSGN_ISN.NEXTVAL INTO V_ASSGN_ISN FROM DUAL;
 INSERT INTO INSPTR_DCLTNS(PORT_CD, ASSIGN_ISN, DCLTN_ISN, GRP_ID, INSPTR_ID, ASSGIN_DT, END_DATE, RMV_DT, RMV_RSN, REQ_DT, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL,RE_GRP_ID, RE_INSPTR_ID,STATS_ISN)
 VALUES (:STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD, V_ASSGN_ISN, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, :STATS_DCLTNS.STA_U_REQ_DT, :STATS_DCLTNS.STA_U_DCLTN_LEVEL, NULL,NULL, :STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN)
 ;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 15, 4, :STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD||'!'||V_ASSGN_ISN) THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN

 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL = :STATS_DCLTNS.STA_U_DCLTN_LEVEL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = :STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;

 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تحضير المعاملة الجمركية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 DELETE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :STATS_DCLTNS.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = :STATS_DCLTNS.STATS_ISN
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;
 END IF;
END;

Block.Name: TRANSITS
Block.WhereClause:
WHERE ( ( TRANSITS.TRNST_DT > :PARAMETER.DATE_CASE
AND
TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD = :U_PORT_CD
AND
TRANSITS.GROUP_ID = :U_GRP_CD
AND
TRANSITS.TRANST_INSPCTR IS NULL
AND
TRANSITS.BRKR_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL
AND
TRANSITS.TRNST_STATUS_CD >=3
AND
TRANSITS.TRNST_TYPE IN (4,43)
)
)

Trigger.Name: WHEN-CHECKBOX-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF :TRNST_PREEXIST = 1 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT REQ_DT
 INTO :TRANSITS.TRNST_U_REQ_DT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_NBR = :TRANSITS.TRNST_NBR
 AND TRNST_DT = :TRANSITS.TRNST_DT
 AND TRNST_TYPE = :TRANSITS.TRNST_TYPE
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('TRANSITS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'TRANSITS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :TRANSITS.TRNST_U_REQ_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('TRANSITS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'TRANSITS',STATUS, CHANGED_STATUS);
 END;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_NBR = :TRANSITS.TRNST_NBR
 AND TRNST_DT = :TRANSITS.TRNST_DT
 AND TRNST_TYPE = :TRANSITS.TRNST_TYPE
 AND REQ_DT = :TRNST_U_REQ_DT
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;

 :TRNST_U_REQ_DT := NULL;
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('TRANSITS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'TRANSITS',STATUS, CHANGED_STATUS);
 ELSE

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('TRANSITS', CURRENT_RECORD), 'TRANSITS',STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_UTC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'UNLOAD_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_USR_SEAL_INSPCTR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SDP_PORT_CD,SEAL_INSPCTR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_ULC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'UNLOAD_LOC_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_TVC1_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'VIOLATION_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_TSC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRNST_STATUS_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_TRT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRANSPORTER_CODE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_TOT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'OWNER_TYPE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_TDC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'EXIT_CTRY_CD,SDP_PORT_CD,EXIT_PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_TCC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'CLOSING_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_TBA_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRNST_BRK_AUTHR_ISN,SDP_PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_SDG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SDP_PORT_CD,SEAL_GROUP_ID' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_MTC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'MNFST_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_DG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(' خطأ فى رقم المجموعة الجمركية لبيان الترانزيت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_CTRY_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'MSRC_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'MISU_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_ASSGN_ISN NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :TRNST_PREEXIST = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_NBR = :TRANSITS.TRNST_NBR
 AND TRNST_DT = :TRANSITS.TRNST_DT
 AND TRNST_TYPE = :TRANSITS.TRNST_TYPE
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;
 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 SELECT AUTO_ASSGN_ISN.NEXTVAL INTO V_ASSGN_ISN FROM DUAL;
 INSERT INTO INSPTR_DCLTNS(PORT_CD, ASSIGN_ISN, DCLTN_ISN, GRP_ID, INSPTR_ID, ASSGIN_DT, END_DATE, RMV_DT, RMV_RSN, REQ_DT, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL,RE_GRP_ID, RE_INSPTR_ID,TRNST_TYPE,TRNST_NBR,TRNST_DT)
 VALUES (:TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD, V_ASSGN_ISN, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, :TRANSITS.TRNST_U_REQ_DT, :TRANSITS.TRNST_U_DCLTN_LEVEL, NULL,NULL,:TRANSITS.TRNST_TYPE, :TRANSITS.TRNST_NBR,:TRANSITS.TRNST_DT)
 ;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 15, 4, :TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD||'!'||V_ASSGN_ISN) THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN

 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL = :TRANSITS.TRNST_U_DCLTN_LEVEL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_NBR = :TRANSITS.TRNST_NBR
 AND TRNST_DT = :TRANSITS.TRNST_DT
 AND TRNST_TYPE = :TRANSITS.TRNST_TYPE
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;

 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ في تحضير المعاملة الجمركية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 DELETE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :TRANSITS.SDP_PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_NBR = :TRANSITS.TRNST_NBR
 AND TRNST_DT = :TRANSITS.TRNST_DT
 AND TRNST_TYPE = :TRANSITS.TRNST_TYPE
 AND ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 ;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: KEY_CONTROL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY KEY_CONTROL IS
PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY IS
BEGIN

:GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=1;

DECLARE
 FLAG1 NUMBER := 0;
 V_UPDATE NUMBER := 0;
 V_DELETE NUMBER := 0;
 V_INSERT NUMBER := 0;

 CURSOR C_FK(VROLE VARCHAR2) IS

 SELECT RL_SYS_UPDATE,RL_SYS_INSERT,RL_SYS_DELETE
 FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID = VROLE
 AND SYS_TYPE IN (5,6);

 CURSOR C_ROLES IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES SCUR
 WHERE USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCUR.ROLE_ID)
 UNION
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES SCGR,SC_USER_GROUPS SCUG
 WHERE SCUG.GROUP_ID = SCGR.GROUP_ID
 AND SCUG.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND SCUG.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND GR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCGR.ROLE_ID)
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1;
 vc varchar2(2000) ;
 vrol_password varchar2(200) ;
 V_ROLE VARCHAR2(2000);

BEGIN
 FOR J in c_roles LOOP
 FOR I IN C_FK(J.ROLE_ID)LOOP
 FLAG1 :=1;
 IF I.RL_SYS_INSERT =1 THEN V_INSERT := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_DELETE =1 THEN V_DELETE := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_UPDATE =1 THEN V_UPDATE := 1 ; END IF;

 END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF FLAG1 =1 THEN
 IF V_INSERT = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_DELETE =0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END;
 FK_DISPLAY;
END;



 PROCEDURE FK_DISPLAY IS
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.V_INSERT = 0 AND :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.SAVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.V_DELETE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.REMOVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END PRINT_REPORT;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;


 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD <> 98 THEN
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;
 END IF ;
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_USER_ID VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_ROLE_ID VARCHAR2(30);
BEGIN
BEGIN
 SELECT UR.ROLE_ID INTO V_ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 UNION
 SELECT GR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR, SC_USER_GROUPS UG
 WHERE UG.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UG.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND GR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND GR.GROUP_ID = UG.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UER.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN(FALSE);
END;
 IF V_ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL' THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE for_edi_msg(msg_count OUT NUMBER) IS
BEGIN
 /* ----OLD STATEMENT------
 select count(*) into msg_count
 from MSG_HDRS mh
 where msg_for_user.is_msg_for_usr(mh.MSG_ID,:parameter.p_user_id,:parameter.p_class_cd,:parameter.p_user_type) = 1

ProgramUnit.Name: WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG IS

 Timer_Expired varchar2(30);
 Tim timer;
 dummy varchar2(32);

begin
 Timer_Expired := Get_Application_Property(TIMER_NAME);
 if Timer_Expired = 'TURN' then
 dummy := To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS));
 if dummy <= 5.5 then
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 5.5);
 Delete_Timer('TURN');
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))-0.006);
 end if;

 :global.timer := 1;
 elsif Timer_Expired = 'RETURN' then
 if To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS)) >= 8.5 then
--Stop this timer
 Delete_Timer('RETURN');
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 8.5);
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))+0.006);
 end if;
 :global.timer := 2;
 END IF;
END;

 CLOSE C;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ - تكرار في رقم البيان الإحصائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRANSIT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'SDP_PORT_CD,TRNST_NBR,TRNST_DT,TRNST_TYP' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TRNST_GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION TRNST_GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_LEVEL NUMBER := 1;
BEGIN

 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') THEN
 IF TRNST_GET_VHTR_CNT = 0 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 1 ;
 ELSE
 V_LEVEL := TRNST_GET_VHTR_CNT ;

 END IF ;

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 V_LEVEL := 1;
 END IF;



 RETURN (V_LEVEL);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: STA_GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION STA_GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_STATS_ISN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_LEVEL NUMBER := 1;
BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BI.CNTNR_SEQ)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO, SEA_DLVY_ITEMS DI, VSSL_BL_ITEMS BI
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SDO.STATS_DCLTN_ISN = V_STATS_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND DI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND DI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND BI.PORT_CD = DI.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND BI.MFST_TYPE = DI.MFST_TYPE
 AND BI.MFST_NBR = DI.MFST_NBR
 AND BI.MFST_DT = DI.MFST_DT
 AND BI.BL_SEQ = DI.BL_SEQ
 AND BI.ITEM_SEQ = DI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND BI.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;

 IF V_COUNT >= 1 AND V_COUNT <= 3 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 2;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 3 AND V_COUNT <= 7 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 3;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 7 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 4;
 END IF;

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') THEN
 IF STA_GET_VHTR_CNT = 0 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 1 ;
 ELSE
 V_LEVEL := STA_GET_VHTR_CNT ;

 END IF ;

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 V_LEVEL := 1;
 END IF;



 RETURN (V_LEVEL);
END;

FUNCTION STA_GET_CNTR_CNT RETURN NUMBER IS

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BI.CNTNR_SEQ)
