ProgramUnit.Name: SADR_INI
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- yasser hassan update 06042021
PROCEDURE SADR_INI IS

v_port_type NUMBER;
V_recp_flag NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
v_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD NUMBER;
V_SEND_INI NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
v_msg_txt VARCHAR2 (500);
p_out_msg VARCHAR2 (500);
p_out_result NUMBER;
V_CURR_port_cd VARCHAR2(100):= gnrl.get_customs_setting ('PORT_CD', 999);
V_BL_QTY NUMBER;
V_IN_QTY NUMBER;
V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_MFST_NBR NUMBER;
 V_MFST_DT DATE;
 V_BL_SEQ NUMBER;
 V_L NUMBER;





BEGIN




 SELECT recp_flag
 INTO V_recp_flag
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd =:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_isn = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;






 IF V_recp_flag = 1 THEN

 SELECT DISTINCT PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
 INTO V_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
 FROM VSSL_BLS
 WHERE port_cd =:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_SEND_INI
 FROM MSG_HDRS
 WHERE MSG_TYPE = 'DECINI'
 AND PORT_CD =:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND PORT_CNTRCTR_CD = V_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD;



-----------------------------------------------------------


 --IF V_SEND_INI = 0
 --THEN
 IF NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('LINK_PC_IMPORT', 21), 0) <> 0

 AND LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.BL_PARTS_APPLIED(:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD, :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)
 <> 0
 THEN

 EDI_TRG.DATABASE_XML_CREATE (2,
 'IDEC_MSG.DecIni',
 'DatabaseDecInspectIni',
 'DEC',
 'DECLARATIONS',
 :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN,
 'JAVA_P_user_id'
 );
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 166, :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD||'!'||:DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --END IF;


FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LANDSTATSSAMECONTAINER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION LandSTATSSameContainer(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_STATS_ISN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

V_INSPTR_ID VARCHAR2(100);
CURSOR CONTAINER_CURS IS
 SELECT TRAN_SEQ,PORT_CD,TRANS_DATE_H
 FROM STATS_VHCLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = V_STATS_ISN ;


BEGIN
FOR I IN CONTAINER_CURS LOOP
 BEGIN
 SELECT INSPTR_NBR INTO V_INSPTR_ID
 FROM STATS_VHCLS,STATS_DCLTNS S
 WHERE
 (STATS_VHCLS.PORT_CD =S.PORT_CD)
 AND (STATS_VHCLS.STATS_ISN =S.STATS_ISN)
 AND (STATS_VHCLS.PORT_CD =I.PORT_CD )
 AND (STATS_VHCLS.TRAN_SEQ =I.TRAN_SEQ )
 AND (STATS_VHCLS.TRANS_DATE_H =I.TRANS_DATE_H )
 AND S.INSPTR_NBR IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM<=1;
 RETURN V_INSPTR_ID;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END ;
END LOOP;
 RETURN NULL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LANDDCLTNSAMECONTAINER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION LandDcltnSameContainer(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

V_INSPTR_ID VARCHAR2(100);
CURSOR CONTAINER_CURS IS
 SELECT DISTINCT DLMT.TRAN_SEQ TRAN_SEQ,DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H TRANS_DATE_H,DLMT.PORT_CD PORT_CD
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT,DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE
 (DLM.PORT_CD =V_PORT_CD)
 AND (DLM.DCLTN_ISN =V_DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DLM.PORT_CD =DLMT.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN =DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN )
 -- AND (DLMT.PORT_CD =VT.PORT_CD )
 -- AND (DLMT.TRAN_SEQ =VT.TRAN_SEQ )
 -- AND (DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H =VT.TRANS_DATE_H )

 UNION

 SELECT DISTINCT DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR TRAN_SEQ,DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE TRANS_DATE_H,DGT.PORT_CD PORT_CD
 FROM
 DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE


 (DGT.PORT_CD =V_PORT_CD)
 AND (DGT.DCLTN_ISN =V_DCLTN_ISN)
 -- AND (DGT.PORT_CD =VT.PORT_CD)
 -- AND (DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE =VT.TRANS_DATE_H)
 --AND (DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR =VT.TRAN_SEQ)
 AND (DGT.DGT_TYPE =4);



BEGIN
FOR I IN CONTAINER_CURS LOOP

 BEGIN
 SELECT INSPTR_ID INTO V_INSPTR_ID
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT,DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM,DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE
 (DLM.PORT_CD =D.PORT_CD)
 AND (DLM.DCLTN_ISN =D.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DLM.PORT_CD =DLMT.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN =DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN )
 AND (DLMT.PORT_CD =I.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLMT.TRAN_SEQ =I.TRAN_SEQ )
 AND (DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H =I.TRANS_DATE_H )
 AND D.INSPTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM<=1;
 RETURN V_INSPTR_ID;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT INSPTR_ID INTO V_INSPTR_ID
 FROM DECLARATIONS D,DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE
 (DGT.DCLTN_ISN =D.DCLTN_ISN)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD =D.PORT_CD)
 AND (DGT.PORT_CD =I.PORT_CD)
 AND (DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE =I.TRANS_DATE_H)
 AND (DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR =I.TRAN_SEQ)
 AND (DGT.DGT_TYPE =4)
 AND D.INSPTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM<=1;
 RETURN V_INSPTR_ID;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
 END ;

 END ;

END LOOP;
 RETURN NULL;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_BOUND_CNTNR

FUNCTION IS_BOUND_CNTNR
RETURN NUMBER
IS
V_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE <> 1 THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VC
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SDO.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SDO.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR
 AND SDO.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE
 AND SDI.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR
 AND SDI.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT
 AND SDI.BL_SEQ = VBI.BL_SEQ
 AND SDI.ITEM_SEQ = VBI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND VBI.PORT_CD = VC.PORT_CD
 AND VBI.MFST_TYPE = VC.MFST_TYPE
 AND VBI.MFST_NBR = VC.MFST_NBR
 AND VBI.MFST_DT = VC.MFST_DT
 AND VBI.CNTNR_SEQ = VC.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND SDO.DO_ISS_LOC_CD <> 2
 AND NOT(VC.SHPMT_TYPE_CD = 2 OR VC.STRG_LOC_CD IN (1, 2)) ;


 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN

 ELSE

 END IF;


 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN 0;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
 V_LEVEL NUMBER := 1;
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BI.CNTNR_SEQ)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO, SEA_DLVY_ITEMS DI, VSSL_BL_ITEMS BI
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND DI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND DI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND BI.PORT_CD = DI.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND BI.MFST_TYPE = DI.MFST_TYPE
 AND BI.MFST_NBR = DI.MFST_NBR
 AND BI.MFST_DT = DI.MFST_DT
 AND BI.BL_SEQ = DI.BL_SEQ
 AND BI.ITEM_SEQ = DI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND BI.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;

 IF V_COUNT >= 1 AND V_COUNT <= 3 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 2;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 3 AND V_COUNT <= 7 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 3;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 7 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 4;
 END IF;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') THEN
 IF GET_VHTR_CNT = 0 THEN
 V_LEVEL := 1 ;
 ELSE
 V_LEVEL := GET_VHTR_CNT ;
 END IF ;

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
 V_LEVEL := 1;
 END IF;



 RETURN (V_LEVEL);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_VHTR_CNT

FUNCTION GET_VHTR_CNT RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_CNT NUMBER ;
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT
 FROM

 (
 SELECT DISTINCT VT.PLATE_NO,VT.TRAN_SEQ,VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT,DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT,DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM,DECLARATIONS D

 AND (DLM.PORT_CD =DLMT.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN =DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN )
 AND (DLMT.PORT_CD =VT.PORT_CD )
 AND (DLMT.TRAN_SEQ =VT.TRAN_SEQ )
 AND (DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H =VT.TRANS_DATE_H )

 UNION

 SELECT DISTINCT VT.PLATE_NO,VT.TRAN_SEQ,VT.TRANS_DATE_H
 FROM DECLARATIONS D,DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT,VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT

 AND (DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR =VT.TRAN_SEQ)
 AND (DGT.DGT_TYPE =4)
 );

 RETURN V_CNT ;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2016/01/24 11:48 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
FUNCTION get_min_job_insptr (
 v_port_cd NUMBER,
 v_grp_id NUMBER,
 v_shift_id NUMBER,
 p_port_cd NUMBER,
 p_dcltn_isn NUMBER
)
 RETURN CHAR
IS
 v_user VARCHAR2 (200);
 h_date DATE;
 third_shift NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2 (100);
 sdate DATE;
 edate DATE;
 v_old_insptr_id VARCHAR2 (50);
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT insptr_id
 INTO v_old_insptr_id
 FROM insptr_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = p_dcltn_isn
 AND insptr_id IS NOT NULL;
--str.dispalert('m000 p_port_cd ==> '||p_port_cd,'error');
--str.dispalert('m000 p_dcltn_isn ==> '||p_dcltn_isn,'error');
--str.dispalert('m000 v_old_insptr_id ==> '||v_old_insptr_id,'error');--
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
--str.dispalert('m000 error','error');--
 v_old_insptr_id := 'MH';
 END;

/* NIHAD KHALIL FAGEM FOR 3THSHIFT DISTRIBUTED MINUS DAY FROM CURRENT DATE */
 h_date := hijdate.cur_hij_date;

 IF f3dshift (v_port_cd, v_grp_id, v_shift_id) = 1
 THEN
 IF TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') < :GLOBAL.shift_et
 THEN
 h_date := hijdate_db.add_hij_days (h_date, -1, v_msg_txt);
 END IF;
 ---- TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24:MI')> :GLOBAL.SHIFT_ST THEN --
 END IF;

--==========================================================================
 IF (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('HEAD_GROUP_EXCEPTION', 21), 0) = 0)
 THEN
 FOR i IN (SELECT ig.user_id user_id
 FROM insptr_grps ig, insptr_wrkshts iws
 WHERE ig.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND ig.grp_id = v_grp_id
 AND iws.shift_id = v_shift_id
 AND ig.rec_status = 1
 AND iws.port_cd = ig.port_cd
 AND iws.grp_id = ig.grp_id
 AND iws.insptr_nbr = ig.user_id
 AND iws.wrksht_dt = h_date
 AND iws.exist = 1
-- --> 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition
/*
 -------------------------- MAIH 02-11-2011
 AND
 (
 (
 IG.USER_ID <> :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('HEAD_GROUP_EXCEPTION',21) = 1
 )
 OR
 (
 NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('HEAD_GROUP_EXCEPTION',21),0) = 0
 )
 )
 -----------------------------------------
*/
-- --< 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition
 AND ig.work_assign_level =
 (SELECT MIN (ig2.work_assign_level)
 FROM insptr_grps ig2, insptr_wrkshts iws2
 WHERE ig2.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND ig2.grp_id = v_grp_id
 AND iws2.shift_id = v_shift_id
 AND ig2.rec_status = 1
 AND iws2.port_cd = ig2.port_cd
 AND iws2.grp_id = ig2.grp_id
 AND iws2.insptr_nbr = ig2.user_id
 AND iws2.wrksht_dt = h_date
 AND ig2.user_id != v_old_insptr_id
 AND iws2.exist = 1)
 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE)
 LOOP
--str.dispalert('m001 v_old_insptr_id ==> '||v_old_insptr_id||' i.user_id ==> '||i.user_id ,'error');--
 --IF v_old_insptr_id != i.user_id
 --THEN
 RETURN (i.user_id);
 --END IF;
 END LOOP;
--====================================================================
 ELSIF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('HEAD_GROUP_EXCEPTION', 21), 0) = 1
 THEN
 FOR i IN (SELECT ig.user_id user_id
 FROM insptr_grps ig, insptr_wrkshts iws
 WHERE ig.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND ig.grp_id = v_grp_id
-- --> 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition
 AND ig.user_id != :parameter.p_user_id
-- --< 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition
 AND iws.shift_id = v_shift_id
 AND ig.rec_status = 1
 AND iws.port_cd = ig.port_cd
 AND iws.grp_id = ig.grp_id
 AND iws.insptr_nbr = ig.user_id
 AND iws.wrksht_dt = h_date
 AND iws.exist = 1
-- --> 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition
/*
 -------------------------- MAIH 02-11-2011
 AND
 (
 (
 IG.USER_ID <> :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('HEAD_GROUP_EXCEPTION',21) = 1
 )
 OR
 (
 NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('HEAD_GROUP_EXCEPTION',21),0) = 0
 )
 )
 -----------------------------------------
*/
-- --< 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition
 AND ig.work_assign_level =
 (SELECT MIN (ig2.work_assign_level)
 FROM insptr_grps ig2, insptr_wrkshts iws2
 WHERE ig2.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND ig2.grp_id = v_grp_id
 AND iws2.shift_id = v_shift_id
 AND ig2.rec_status = 1
-- --> 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition
 AND ig2.user_id != :parameter.p_user_id
-- --< 15/11/2011 AHMED A-MONIM Chng Condition --
 AND iws2.port_cd = ig2.port_cd
 AND iws2.grp_id = ig2.grp_id
 AND iws2.insptr_nbr = ig2.user_id
 AND iws2.wrksht_dt = h_date
 AND ig2.user_id != v_old_insptr_id
 AND iws2.exist = 1)
 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE)
 LOOP
--str.dispalert('m002 v_old_insptr_id ==> '||v_old_insptr_id||' i.user_id ==> '||i.user_id ,'error');--
 --IF v_old_insptr_id != i.user_id
 --THEN
 RETURN (i.user_id);
 --END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;

 RETURN NULL;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(100);

/* NIHAD KHALIL FAGEM FOR 3THSHIFT DISTRIBUTED MINUS DAY FROM CURRENT DATE */

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUNS(CD VARCHAR2) IS
v_contract_grp NUMBER;
ALLOW_DIST NUMBER;
 V_FART_SETTING NUMBER := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('PORT_CD',999),'BULK_DCLTN_CR9721',21),'0');
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_contract_grp
FROM DCLTN_CONTRACTOR_GRP
WHERE PORT_CD = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD
AND GRP_ID_MANUAL = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD;
ALLOW_DIST := LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.INSPTR_WRKSHTS_CONFIRM(:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD, :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD, :INSPTR_GRPS.U_SHIFT_ID,HIJDATE_db.Cur_Hij_Date);
IF ALLOW_DIST = 0 AND CD IN ('CD_01222','RE_DIS''CD_DCLN4001' ) THEN -- CR-7284
STR.DISPALERT('يجب تأكيد تحضير المعاينين','ERROR');
TERMINATE_FUN;
END IF;
 IF CD LIKE 'CD_01222' THEN
 IF :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting ('ATU_DISTRIB_DCLT', 21), 0) = 1 AND v_contract_grp > 0
 AND ((IS_FART_DCLTN = 0 AND V_FART_SETTING = 1) OR V_FART_SETTING = 0)-- FART CR-9721
 AND IS_BOUND_CNTNR = 0
 AND CHECK_DCLTN_CNTNRS_ISNSP = 0
 THEN
 LIB_USR.hours24.auto_dist_insp(:INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD,:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD);
 STR.DISPALERT('تمت عملية التوزيع بنجاح','INFORMATION');
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 ELSE
 AUTO_ASSIGN(:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD, :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD, :INSPTR_GRPS.U_SHIFT_ID);
 IF :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID <> 9086 THEN
 GO_BLOCK('DECLARATIONS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);

 GO_BLOCK('STATS_DCLTNS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);

 ELSE
 GO_BLOCK('STATS_DCLTNS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);

 GO_BLOCK('TRANSITS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحديد رقم المجموعة أولا','ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSIF CD LIKE 'RE_DIS' THEN
 CALL_LOV_INSP_REDIST;
-- CR-7284
ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_DCLN4001' THEN
 CALL_UNASSAIN_FORM ();
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_GRP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_GRP(P_PORT_CD NUMBER,P_GRP_CD NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT SHIFT_ID,SFT_STIME,SFT_ETIME
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 AND STATUS = 1
 ORDER BY TO_CHAR(SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI') DESC;

 V_SI NUMBER;
 V_ST DATE;
 V_ET DATE;
 V_TST NUMBER := 0 ;
 V_CNT1 NUMBER;
 V_CNT2 NUMBER;
 G_DATE DATE;

 BEGIN
 G_DATE := SYSDATE;

----------- التأكد من عدم تداخل الفترات بنفس الوقت
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT1
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_PARNT
 WHERE DGS_PARNT.STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_PARNT.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_PARNT.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_CHLD
 WHERE( (TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI') >= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND(TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI') <= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND(DGS_CHLD.ROWID != DGS_PARNT.ROWID )
 AND DGS_CHLD.STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_CHLD.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_CHLD.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 )
 );

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT2
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_PARNT
 WHERE DGS_PARNT.STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_PARNT.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_PARNT.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_CHLD
 WHERE( (TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI') >= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND(TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI') <= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND( DGS_CHLD.ROWID != DGS_PARNT.ROWID )
 AND STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_CHLD.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_CHLD.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 )
 );

 IF V_CNT1 != 0 OR V_CNT2 != 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يوجد خطأ في إعداد الفترات .. لا يمكن تحضير المعاينين','ERROR');
-- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;
--------------------------------------------------------
 OPEN C1;
 LOOP
 FETCH C1 INTO V_SI,V_ST,V_ET;
 --الفترة بنفس اليوم --
 IF V_ET > V_ST THEN
 IF TO_CHAR(G_DATE,'HH24:MI') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(V_ST,'HH24:MI') AND TO_CHAR(V_ET,'HH24:MI') THEN
 V_TST := 1;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- الفترة بيومين
 -- الفترة بيومين و الوقت الأن في اليوم الأول --
 IF TO_CHAR(G_DATE,'HH24:MI') > TO_CHAR(V_ST,'HH24:MI') THEN
 V_TST := 1;
 ELSE --الفترة بيومين والوقت الأن في اليوم الثاني --
 --الوقت قبل انتهاء الفترة
 IF TO_CHAR(G_DATE,'HH24:MI') < TO_CHAR(V_ET,'HH24:MI') THEN
 /*NIHAD KHALIL STOP CODE FOR WORK 3THSHIFT */ --V_TST := 2;
 V_TST := 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN V_TST IN (1,2) OR C1%NOTFOUND;
 END LOOP;
 IF V_TST = 2 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحضير المعاينين في اليوم الأول من الفترة .. لا يمكن تحضير المعاينين','ERROR');
 -- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;
 IF C1%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لم يتم تسجيل وردية لهذه المجموعة .. لا يمكن تحضير المعاينين','ERROR');
-- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 CLOSE C1;
 RETURN 1;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DCLTN_GRP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_DCLTN_GRP IS -- maih
v_cnt NUMBER :=0 ;
BEGIN

SELECT MAX (gid)
 INTO v_cnt
FROM (SELECT COUNT(grp_id) gid
 FROM dcltn_grps dg
 WHERE ( mgr_id = :parameter.p_user_id OR DEPUTY_MGR_ID = :parameter.p_user_id)
 AND grp_id = :U_GRP_CD -- MAIH
 AND grp_status = 1
 UNION
 SELECT COUNT(shift_id) gid
 FROM dcltn_grp_shifts
 WHERE ( (manger = :parameter.p_user_id)
 OR (deputy_mgr_id = :parameter.p_user_id)
 )
 AND grp_id = :U_GRP_CD -- MAIH
 AND status = 1);





 IF v_cnt = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن التعامل مع بيان فى مجموعة غير مجموعتك','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ;
 END IF;
END;

FUNCTION CHECK_DCLTN_CNTNRS_ISNSP
RETURN NUMBER
IS
V_LCL_COUNT NUMBER;
V_MANUAL_COUNT NUMBER;
V_BO_AREA_COUNT NUMBER;
V_DOG_COUNT NUMBER;

V_CNT NUMBER;

 :PARAMETER.CNTNRS_ISNSP:= 0 ;

 HOURS24.CHECK_DCLTN_CNTNRS_ISNSP (:DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD,

PROCEDURE CALL_LOV_INSP_REDIST IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_INSPCTRS';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_DATE DATE;
v_contract_grp NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_contract_grp
FROM DCLTN_CONTRACTOR_GRP
WHERE PORT_CD = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD
AND GRP_ID_MANUAL = :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD;


 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة إختيار المعاينين');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 6.5);

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_GRP_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_INSP_REDIST.FMX',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting ('ATU_DISTRIB_DCLT', 21), 0) = 1 AND v_contract_grp > 0 THEN
 V_DATE :=TO_DATE(:GLOBAL.V_DATE,'MI-MM-YYYY');
 ret := str.dispalert (' سيتم توزيع معاملات المعاين '||:GLOBAL.USR_ANAME||' لتاريخ '||TO_CHAR(V_DATE,'MI-MM-YYYY'), 'CONFIRM');
 IF ret = alert_button1
 THEN
 LIB_USR.hours24.auto_redist_insp(:GLOBAL.USER_ID,V_DATE,:INSPTR_GRPS.U_GRP_CD,:INSPTR_GRPS.U_PORT_CD);
 STR.DISPALERT('تمت عملية إعادة التوزيع بنجاح','INFORMATION');
 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحديد رقم المجموعة أولا','ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END;

PROCEDURE AUTO_ASSIGN_ORG (P_PORT_CD NUMBER, P_GRP_ID NUMBER, P_SHIFT_ID NUMBER)
IS
 v_24hours NUMBER := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS', 21), 0);
 v_24hours_start_dt DATE := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_START_DT', 21),'1450-01-01'),'YYYY-MM-MI');
 v_24hoursexp NUMBER := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURSEXP', 21), 0);
 v_24hoursexp_start_dt DATE := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURSEXP_START_DT', 21),'1450-01-01'),'YYYY-MM-MI');
 v_24hours_STATS NUMBER := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_STATS', 27), 0);
 v_24hours_STATS_dt DATE := TO_DATE (NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('24HOURS_STATS_DT', 27),'1450-01-01'),'YYYY-MM-MI');
 V_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC_5913 NUMBER := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('ALOW_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC', 21), 0); -- cr-5913
 v_port_type NUMBER := GNRL.get_customs_setting ('PORT_TYPE', 999);
 V_EXPERS NUMBER; -- CR-8879
 CURSOR C_INSPTR_DCLTNS (
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER,
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER)
 IS
 /* Modified By Mohamed Taha 18-08-2025 issue in CR-5913 */
 SELECT *
 FROM (SELECT ID.PORT_CD,
 ID.ASSIGN_ISN,
 ID.DCLTN_ISN,
 ID.STATS_ISN,
 ID.TRNST_TYPE,
 ID.TRNST_NBR,
 ID.TRNST_DT,
 1 DCLN_TYPE,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM DECLARATIONS D, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE D.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND D.INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND ID.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND ID.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 AND id.REQ_DT >=
 HIJDATE_DB.ADD_HIJ_DAYS (
 HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE,
 -15)
 AND D.DCLTN_DT >= NVL ( :DATE_CASE, :PARAMETER.DATE_CASE)
 AND (LIB_USR.DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT (D.PORT_CD,D.DCLTN_ISN,D.dcltn_type_cd) = 1) -- wakeel cr_6601_2 waiting list
 AND (NVL (D.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 OR D.dcltn_dt < v_24hours_start_dt
 OR v_24hours = 0
 OR dcltn_type_cd NOT IN (1, 2)
 )
 ----
 AND (NVL (D.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 OR D.dcltn_dt < v_24hoursexp_start_dt
 OR v_24hoursexp = 0
 OR dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 )
 ----
 AND (dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 OR LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.BL_PARTS_APPLIED (
 ID.PORT_CD,
 ID.DCLTN_ISN) = 1)
 ----
 AND (v_port_type <> 3
 OR (v_port_type = 3
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4, 5)
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_EXPERS) -- CR-8879
 OR (v_port_type = 3
 AND LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS (D.PORT_CD,D.DCLTN_ISN,1) = 1) -- CR3515 -- and CR-5913
 AND (DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLOW_DIST_WITH_PREVIEW (D.PORT_CD,D.DCLTN_ISN,1) = 1)
 ) -- MOHAMED TAHA CR-7431 -- CR3515 -- and CR-5913
 -- cr_7466
 /* UNION
 SELECT ID.*, 2 DCLN_TYPE, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM STATS_DCLTNS SD, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE SD.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SD.GRP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND SD.INSPTR_NBR IS NULL
 AND ID.PORT_CD = SD.PORT_CD
 AND ID.STATS_ISN = SD.STATS_ISN
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 AND ( NVL (SD.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 OR SD.STATS_dt < v_24hours_STATS_dt
 OR v_24hours_STATS = 0)
 ----------------------------------AHMED MOMEN ------CR-3402-----11-01-2022---------------
 AND ( SD.STATS_TYPE_CD IN (11, 13, 15)
 OR Prtl_nebras_services.stats_bl_parts_applied (
 SD.PORT_CD,
 SD.STATS_ISN) = 1)
 AND (STATS_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT (SD.PORT_CD,
 SD.STATS_ISN) =
 1) -- MOHAMED TAHA CR-8440 07-04-2025
 AND (DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLOW_DIST_WITH_PREVIEW (
 SD.PORT_CD,
 SD.STATS_ISN,
 2) = 1) -- MOHAMED TAHA CR-7431
 -----------------------------*********************-------------------------------
 AND ( v_port_type <> 3
 OR ( v_port_type = 3
 AND LIB_USR.prtl_nebras_services.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS (
 SD.PORT_CD,
 SD.STATS_ISN,
 2) = 1)) -- CR3515 -- and CR-5913
 UNION
 SELECT ID.*, 3 DCLN_TYPE, WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM TRANSITS TR, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE TR.SDP_PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND TR.GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND TR.TRANST_INSPCTR IS NULL
 AND ID.PORT_CD = TR.SDP_PORT_CD
 AND ID.TRNST_TYPE = TR.TRNST_TYPE
 AND ID.TRNST_NBR = TR.TRNST_NBR
 AND ID.TRNST_DT = TR.TRNST_DT
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL*/
 )
 ORDER BY WRK_ASN_LVL DESC, DCLN_TYPE;

 V_INSPTR VARCHAR2 (200);
 H_DATE DATE;
 G_DATE DATE := SYSDATE;
 V_DONE NUMBER := 0; --CR-5913
 V_ISD_AIR NUMBER; -- CR-8441
 V_CHECK NUMBER := 0; -- CR-8441
 ISD_AIR_FLG NUMBER; -- CR-8441
 v_count NUMBER;
 V_HAWKMA_VHCL NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('HAWKMA_VHCL', 14), 0); -- cr-8879
 CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL NUMBER; -- cr-8879
 V_TRANS_DATE_H DATE; -- cr-8879
 V_TRAN_SEQ NUMBER; -- cr-8879
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_EXPERS
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE GRP_TYPE = 3 AND PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD; -- CR-8879
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 V_EXPERS := -1;
 END;

 H_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;

 FOR I IN C_INSPTR_DCLTNS (P_PORT_CD, P_GRP_ID)
 LOOP
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_LND')
 THEN
 V_HAWKMA_VHCL :=
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('HAWKMA_VHCL', 14), 0); -- cr-8879

 IF V_HAWKMA_VHCL = 1
 THEN -- cr-8879
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN AND port_CD = I.PORT_CD;

 IF CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL = 0
 THEN -- البيان غير تابع لطلب التغير
 NULL;
 ELSIF CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL >= 1
 THEN -- البيان تابع لطلب التغير
 -- CONTINUE ;
 SELECT TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_SEQ
 INTO V_TRANS_DATE_H, V_TRAN_SEQ
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN AND port_CD = I.PORT_CD;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND HAWKMA_STA_CD IS NULL;

 IF CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL > 0
 THEN -- البيان حوكمة لا يتم توزيع او بيان حوكمه على نفس الشاحن لا يتم التوزيع
 V_CHECK := 1;
 ELSE -- البيان ليس حوكمة سيتم التحقق من المعاين
 BEGIN
 SELECT INSPTR_ID
 INTO V_INSPTR
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID
 AND SHIFT_ID = P_SHIFT_ID; -- التحقق هل هناك بيان له معاين لنفس الشاحنة
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 V_INSPTR :=
 GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR (P_PORT_CD,
 P_GRP_ID,
 P_SHIFT_ID,
 i.port_cd,
 i.dcltn_isn);

 IF V_INSPTR IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 UPDATE VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 SET INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR,
 ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE,
 GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID,
 SHIFT_ID = P_SHIFT_ID
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN
 AND port_CD = I.PORT_CD;
 END IF;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
 THEN
 SELECT INSPTR_ID
 INTO V_INSPTR
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID
 AND SHIFT_ID = P_SHIFT_ID
 AND ROWNUM = 1; -- التحقق هل هناك بيان له معاين لنفس الشاحنة
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_INSPTR IS NULL AND V_CHECK = 0
 THEN
 V_INSPTR :=
 GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR (P_PORT_CD,
 P_GRP_ID,
 P_SHIFT_ID,
 i.port_cd,
 i.dcltn_isn);
 END IF; --CR-8879
 ELSE
 V_INSPTR :=
 GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR (P_PORT_CD,
 P_GRP_ID,
 P_SHIFT_ID,
 i.port_cd,
 i.dcltn_isn);
 END IF; --CR-8879

 BEGIN -- CR-8441 START
 ISD_AIR_FLG := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('ISD_AIR', 21), 0);

 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE =
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 AND ISD_AIR_FLG = 1
 THEN
 V_CHECK := 0;

 /*
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_ISD_AIR
 FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS DIT
 WHERE DIT.INSPECT_TYPE_CD = 3
 AND ISD_RESULT IS NULL
 AND DIT.PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND DIT.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;
 */
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_ISD_AIR
 FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS XPR
 WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN
 AND XPR.ISD_RESULT IS NULL;

 IF v_ISD_AIR >= 1
 THEN
 V_CHECK := 1;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 V_CHECK := 0;
 END IF;
 END;

 IF V_CHECK = 0
 THEN
 IF V_CHECK = 1 AND V_INSPTR IS NULL
 THEN -- CR-8879
 NULL;
 ELSIF V_INSPTR IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 -- MAIH 02-11-2011
 -- IF except_du_aff (V_INSPTR) THEN -- RETURN TRUE IN NORMAL CASES BUT IN CURRENT USER THEN PASS
 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID,
 INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR,
 ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE,
 ASS_GREG_DT = G_DATE
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD AND ASSIGN_ISN = I.ASSIGN_ISN;

 v_done := 1; --CR-5913

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (21,
 15,
 5,
 I.PORT_CD || '!' || I.ASSIGN_ISN)
 THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF NVL (I.DCLN_TYPE, 1) = 1 -- FART CR_9721
 THEN
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS
 SET INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;

 -- WAKEEL CR_5595
 DECLARE
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF NVL (
 gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH', 21),
 0) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XPR, DECLARATIONS DC
 WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = DC.PORT_CD
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = DC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DC.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4, 5) -- wakeel cr_6601_2
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_CNT > 0
 THEN
 UPDATE XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE
 SET SUSPCT_STAGE_CD = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (
 21,
 1,
 216,
 :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 || '!'
 || :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CR-6559', 21), 0) = 1
 THEN -- added by mahmoud ali issa CR-6559
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XPR
 WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL (sas_flag, 0) = 1;

 IF V_CNT > 0
 THEN
 UPDATE XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE
 SET SUSPCT_STAGE_CD = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (
 21,
 1,
 225,
 :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 || '!'
 || :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- end mahmoud ali issa CR-6559
 END;
 -- WAKEEL CR_5595

 ELSIF I.DCLN_TYPE = 2
 THEN
 UPDATE STATS_DCLTNS
 SET INSPTR_NBR = V_INSPTR
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD AND STATS_ISN = I.STATS_ISN;
 ELSIF I.DCLN_TYPE = 3
 THEN
 UPDATE TRANSITS
 SET TRANST_INSPCTR = V_INSPTR
 WHERE SDP_PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_TYPE = I.TRNST_TYPE
 AND TRNST_NBR = I.TRNST_NBR
 AND TRNST_DT = I.TRNST_DT;
 END IF;

 UPDATE INSPTR_GRPS
 SET ACT_DCLTN_COUNT = ACT_DCLTN_COUNT + 1,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL =
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL + NVL (I.WRK_ASN_LVL, 0) -- FART CR_9721
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID
 AND USER_ID = V_INSPTR;
 -- END IF; --------------------------
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT (
 'لا يمكن الحصول علي معاينين حاضرين في المجموعة - تأكد من خطة الحضور للمجموعة',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_DONE = 1
 THEN --CR-5913
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT ('تمت عملية التوزيع بنجاح',
 'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION AUTO_ASSIGN_ACT RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR VARCHAR2(200);
 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DCLTN_SYS_ID')
--&&& END
 AND VAR_NAME = 'INSPTR_AUTO_ASSIGN'
 ;

 V_AUTO_ASSIGN_NBR := TO_NUMBER(V_AUTO_ASSIGN_CHR);

 IF V_AUTO_ASSIGN_NBR = 1 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: AUTO_ASSIGN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE AUTO_ASSIGN (P_PORT_CD NUMBER, P_GRP_ID NUMBER, P_SHIFT_ID NUMBER)
IS
 V_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC_5913 NUMBER := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('ALOW_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC', 21), 0); -- cr-5913
 v_port_type NUMBER := GNRL.get_customs_setting ('PORT_TYPE', 999);
 V_EXPERS NUMBER; -- CR-8879
 CURSOR C_INSPTR_DCLTNS (
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER,
 V_GRP_ID NUMBER)
 IS
 SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM (
 SELECT ID.PORT_CD,
 D.DCLTN_DT,
 ID.ASSIGN_ISN,
 ID.DCLTN_ISN,
 ID.STATS_ISN,
 ID.TRNST_TYPE,
 ID.TRNST_NBR,
 ID.TRNST_DT,
 1 AS DCLN_TYPE,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL AS WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM DECLARATIONS D, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE ID.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND ID.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND D.INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 AND ID.REQ_DT >=
 HIJDATE_DB.ADD_HIJ_DAYS(
 HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE, -15
 )
 AND NVL(D.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 AND LIB_USR.DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT(
 D.PORT_CD,
 D.DCLTN_ISN,
 D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ) = 1
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2)
 AND (
 V_PORT_TYPE <> 3
 OR (
 V_PORT_TYPE = 3
 AND D.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4, 5)
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_EXPERS
 )
 OR (
 V_PORT_TYPE = 3
 AND LIB_USR.PRTL_NEBRAS_SERVICES.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS(
 D.PORT_CD, D.DCLTN_ISN, 1
 ) = 1
 AND LIB_USR.DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLOW_DIST_WITH_PREVIEW(
 D.PORT_CD, D.DCLTN_ISN, 1
 ) = 1
 )
 )
 UNION ALL
 SELECT ID.PORT_CD,
 D.DCLTN_DT,
 ID.ASSIGN_ISN,
 ID.DCLTN_ISN,
 ID.STATS_ISN,
 ID.TRNST_TYPE,
 ID.TRNST_NBR,
 ID.TRNST_DT,
 1 AS DCLN_TYPE,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL AS WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM DECLARATIONS D, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE ID.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND ID.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND D.INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 AND ID.REQ_DT >=
 HIJDATE_DB.ADD_HIJ_DAYS(
 HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE, -15
 )
 AND NVL(D.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 AND LIB_USR.DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT(
 D.PORT_CD,
 D.DCLTN_ISN,
 D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ) = 1
 AND (
 D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1, 2)
 OR D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IS NULL
 )
 AND LIB_USR.PRTL_NEBRAS_SERVICES.BL_PARTS_APPLIED(
 ID.PORT_CD, ID.DCLTN_ISN
 ) = 1
 AND (
 V_PORT_TYPE <> 3
 OR (
 V_PORT_TYPE = 3
 AND D.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4, 5)
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_EXPERS
 )
 OR (
 V_PORT_TYPE = 3
 AND LIB_USR.PRTL_NEBRAS_SERVICES.VHCL_TRANS_EXISTS(
 D.PORT_CD, D.DCLTN_ISN, 1
 ) = 1
 AND LIB_USR.DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLOW_DIST_WITH_PREVIEW(
 D.PORT_CD, D.DCLTN_ISN, 1
 ) = 1
 )
 )
 UNION ALL
 SELECT ID.PORT_CD,
 D.DCLTN_DT,
 ID.ASSIGN_ISN,
 ID.DCLTN_ISN,
 ID.STATS_ISN,
 ID.TRNST_TYPE,
 ID.TRNST_NBR,
 ID.TRNST_DT,
 1 AS DCLN_TYPE,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL AS WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM DECLARATIONS D, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE ID.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND ID.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND D.INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 AND ID.REQ_DT >=
 HIJDATE_DB.ADD_HIJ_DAYS(
 HIJDATE_DB.CUR_HIJ_DATE, -15
 )
 AND NVL(D.RECP_FLAG, 0) = 1
 AND D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 2
 AND D.PEGA_STATUS IS NULL
 AND :PARAMETER.CNTNRS_ISNSP = 1
)
ORDER BY WRK_ASN_LVL DESC, DCLN_TYPE;




 V_INSPTR VARCHAR2 (200);
 H_DATE DATE;
 G_DATE DATE := SYSDATE;
 V_DONE NUMBER := 0; --CR-5913
 V_ISD_AIR NUMBER; -- CR-8441
 V_CHECK NUMBER := 0; -- CR-8441
 ISD_AIR_FLG NUMBER; -- CR-8441
 v_count NUMBER;
 V_HAWKMA_VHCL NUMBER
 := NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('HAWKMA_VHCL', 14), 0); -- cr-8879
 CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL NUMBER; -- cr-8879
 V_TRANS_DATE_H DATE; -- cr-8879
 V_TRAN_SEQ NUMBER; -- cr-8879
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_EXPERS
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE GRP_TYPE = 3 AND PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD; -- CR-8879
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 V_EXPERS := -1;
 END;

 H_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;

 FOR I IN C_INSPTR_DCLTNS (P_PORT_CD, P_GRP_ID)
 LOOP
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_LND')
 THEN
 V_HAWKMA_VHCL :=
 NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('HAWKMA_VHCL', 14), 0); -- cr-8879

 IF V_HAWKMA_VHCL = 1
 THEN -- cr-8879
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN AND port_CD = I.PORT_CD;

 IF CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL = 0
 THEN -- البيان غير تابع لطلب التغير
 NULL;
 ELSIF CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL >= 1
 THEN -- البيان تابع لطلب التغير
 -- CONTINUE ;
 SELECT TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_SEQ
 INTO V_TRANS_DATE_H, V_TRAN_SEQ
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN AND port_CD = I.PORT_CD;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND HAWKMA_STA_CD IS NULL;

 IF CHECK_HAWKMA_VHCL > 0
 THEN -- البيان حوكمة لا يتم توزيع او بيان حوكمه على نفس الشاحن لا يتم التوزيع
 V_CHECK := 1;
 ELSE -- البيان ليس حوكمة سيتم التحقق من المعاين
 BEGIN
 SELECT INSPTR_ID
 INTO V_INSPTR
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID
 AND SHIFT_ID = P_SHIFT_ID; -- التحقق هل هناك بيان له معاين لنفس الشاحنة
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 V_INSPTR :=
 GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR (P_PORT_CD,
 P_GRP_ID,
 P_SHIFT_ID,
 i.port_cd,
 i.dcltn_isn);

 IF V_INSPTR IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 UPDATE VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 SET INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR,
 ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE,
 GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID,
 SHIFT_ID = P_SHIFT_ID
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN
 AND port_CD = I.PORT_CD;
 END IF;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
 THEN
 SELECT INSPTR_ID
 INTO V_INSPTR
 FROM VHCL_TRANS_HAWKMA
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID
 AND SHIFT_ID = P_SHIFT_ID
 AND ROWNUM = 1; -- التحقق هل هناك بيان له معاين لنفس الشاحنة
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_INSPTR IS NULL AND V_CHECK = 0
 THEN
 V_INSPTR :=
 GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR (P_PORT_CD,
 P_GRP_ID,
 P_SHIFT_ID,
 i.port_cd,
 i.dcltn_isn);
 END IF; --CR-8879
 ELSE
 V_INSPTR :=
 GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR (P_PORT_CD,
 P_GRP_ID,
 P_SHIFT_ID,
 i.port_cd,
 i.dcltn_isn);
 END IF; --CR-8879

 BEGIN -- CR-8441 START
 ISD_AIR_FLG := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('ISD_AIR', 21), 0);

 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE =
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 AND ISD_AIR_FLG = 1
 THEN
 V_CHECK := 0;

 /*
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_ISD_AIR
 FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS DIT
 WHERE DIT.INSPECT_TYPE_CD = 3
 AND ISD_RESULT IS NULL
 AND DIT.PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND DIT.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;
 */
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_ISD_AIR
 FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS XPR
 WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN
 AND XPR.ISD_RESULT IS NULL;

 IF v_ISD_AIR >= 1
 THEN
 V_CHECK := 1;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 V_CHECK := 0;
 END IF;
 END;

 IF V_CHECK = 0
 THEN
 IF V_CHECK = 1 AND V_INSPTR IS NULL
 THEN -- CR-8879
 NULL;
 ELSIF V_INSPTR IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 -- MAIH 02-11-2011
 -- IF except_du_aff (V_INSPTR) THEN -- RETURN TRUE IN NORMAL CASES BUT IN CURRENT USER THEN PASS
 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID,
 INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR,
 ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE,
 ASS_GREG_DT = G_DATE
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD AND ASSIGN_ISN = I.ASSIGN_ISN;

 v_done := 1; --CR-5913

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (21,
 15,
 5,
 I.PORT_CD || '!' || I.ASSIGN_ISN)
 THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF NVL (I.DCLN_TYPE, 1) = 1 -- FART CR_9721
 THEN
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS
 SET INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;

 -- WAKEEL CR_5595
 DECLARE
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF NVL (
 gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH', 21),
 0) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XPR, DECLARATIONS DC
 WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = DC.PORT_CD
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = DC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DC.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (4, 5) -- wakeel cr_6601_2
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_CNT > 0
 THEN
 UPDATE XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE
 SET SUSPCT_STAGE_CD = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (
 21,
 1,
 216,
 :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 || '!'
 || :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CR-6559', 21), 0) = 1
 THEN -- added by mahmoud ali issa CR-6559
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XPR
 WHERE XPR.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN
 AND NVL (sas_flag, 0) = 1;

 IF V_CNT > 0
 THEN
 UPDATE XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE
 SET SUSPCT_STAGE_CD = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (
 21,
 1,
 225,
 :DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 || '!'
 || :DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF; -- end mahmoud ali issa CR-6559
 END;
 -- WAKEEL CR_5595

 ELSIF I.DCLN_TYPE = 2
 THEN
 UPDATE STATS_DCLTNS
 SET INSPTR_NBR = V_INSPTR
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD AND STATS_ISN = I.STATS_ISN;
 ELSIF I.DCLN_TYPE = 3
 THEN
 UPDATE TRANSITS
 SET TRANST_INSPCTR = V_INSPTR
 WHERE SDP_PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND TRNST_TYPE = I.TRNST_TYPE
 AND TRNST_NBR = I.TRNST_NBR
 AND TRNST_DT = I.TRNST_DT;
 END IF;

 UPDATE INSPTR_GRPS
 SET ACT_DCLTN_COUNT = ACT_DCLTN_COUNT + 1,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL =
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL + NVL (I.WRK_ASN_LVL, 0) -- FART CR_9721
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID
 AND USER_ID = V_INSPTR;
 -- END IF; --------------------------
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT (
 'لا يمكن الحصول علي معاينين حاضرين في المجموعة - تأكد من خطة الحضور للمجموعة',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF V_DONE = 1
 THEN --CR-5913
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT ('تمت عملية التوزيع بنجاح',
 'INFORMATION');
 :u_dcltn_nbr := NULL;
 :u_dcltn_dt := NULL;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 cust_clk Timer;
 SYSTEM_DATE VARCHAR2(20);
 SDATE1 DATE;
 V_FUN_ITEM_REC TMPLT.CUR_Fun_Items%ROWTYPE;
 x number := 0.0;
-- y number := 5.25;
 y number := 5.17;
 RET PLS_INTEGER;
 WND PLS_INTEGER;
 ENAB VARCHAR2(100);

begin
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY('CGSO$WINDOW_1',WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);

 WND := WIN_API_UTILITY.GET_ACTIVE_WINDOW();
 RET := SEC_DLL.IsWndCaptionDisplayed(WND);
 IF RET = 1 THEN

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 BEGIN
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(TIMER_ID) THEN
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER', 1, REPEAT);
 END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TIMER-EXPIRED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 THE_TIMER VARCHAR2(40) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 v_inactive_time NUMBER;
 V_msg_count NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'CHECKTIMEOUT' THEN
 v_inactive_time := Win_API_Session.Timeout_get_inactive_time;
 IF v_inactive_time >= 600 then
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Delete_Timer;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 1;
 BELL;
 EXIT_FORM (NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSIF v_inactive_time >= 360 then
 BELL;
 END IF;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_ERROR_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_MESSAGE_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'EDI_MSG' THEN
 for_edi_msg(V_msg_count);
 IF V_msg_count > 0 THEN
 BELL;BELL;BELL;BELL;
 :EDI_MSG.EDI_MSG_TXT := 'توجد رسائل بعدد '|| V_msg_count ||' مطلوب اتخاذ اجراءات عليها';
 TURN_MSG;
 end if;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'RETURN_EDI_MSG' THEN
 RETURN_MSG;
 END IF;
 WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG;
END;
